risk: Unauthorized or inconsistent proxy configuration may redirect or interrupt endpoint traffic.
control_objective: Endpoint proxy configuration is authorized and consistent with the approved baseline.
criteria: Observed listener/path evidence is consistent with the approved endpoint configuration
procedure: Collect WinINET, WinHTTP, policy, listener, and timestamped custody evidence
Record deviations as exceptions rather than converting anomaly severity directly into a conclusion
scope: Illustrative Windows endpoint proxy control test
limitations: Portfolio demonstration only; not a formal audit opinion
Conclusion is bounded by the evidence and population snapshot supplied to the test
